description: Given businesses you already found for the user (name plus phone, website or address with ZIP code), report which ones can be booked through Canopy and how (booking_mode). An entry that is not bookable says why (reason); needs_confirmation means use resolve_business so the user can confirm it. Results come back in exactly the order you sent them. Canopy never ranks, filters or recommends businesses. Results are returned in the same order as the input.

businesses.description: 1 to 50 businesses, in your order. Results keep this order.

address.description: City, state and ZIP code of the business.

business_name.description: Business name as you found it. With no phone or website, add the address city, state or ZIP when known.

name: canopy_check_bookable
title: Check which businesses are bookable
